description: Pre-signature transfer check (payment screening): is it safe to send `amount` of `asset` from `from` to `to`? Returns allow / review / block with reasons - sanctioned or flagged parties, malicious or scam token, look-alike address poisoning, first-time payee. Works before the transaction exists; no chain lookup needed. Use in wallet, custody, payment and treasury flows. Builder plan and above.
name: screen_transfer
title: Screen transfer (pre-sign)
